<h2 class="subtitle">Previous work</h2>

- One of two early Rails developers on the core team building <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/lummo-official/about/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Lummo</a>’s backend and GraphQL APIs. Its bookkeeping app served small businesses in Indonesia and reached 2 million monthly active users.

Later <a href="https://x.com/arjun_builds/status/1715144917595693159" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">sold</a> one SaaS product and managed its technical handover.
